description: Get a cached snapshot of top DeFi liquidity pools. Filter by protocol (e.g. "uniswap-v3"), chain (e.g. "ethereum"), or token symbol (e.g. "ETH"). Returns TVL, APY, 24h volume, IL risk, and registry enrichment. Data refreshed every 15 minutes.

pool.description: Filter by specific pool address or DeFi Llama pool ID

token.description: Filter pools containing this token symbol, e.g. "ETH", "USDC"

name: pool_snapshot
